name: Reformed Government of the Republic of China
native: 中華民國維新政府 (Zhōnghuá Mínguó Wéixīn Zhèngfǔ)
wikipedia: Reformed Government of the Republic of China

predecessors.name: Republic of China
predecessors.text: the page: 'assigned control of the provinces of Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui as well as the two municipalities of Nanjing and Shanghai'

successors.name: Reorganized National Government of China
successors.text: 'merged into Wang Jingwei's Nanjing-based Reorganized National Government on 30 March 1940'

ledger.x: 28 March 1938: 'established by Liang Hongzhi and others on 28 March 1938 at the National Great Hall', 'assigned control of the provinces of Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui as well as the two municipalities of Nanjing and Shanghai'.

30 March 1940: 'merged into Wang Jingwei's Nanjing-based Reorganized National Government on 30 March 1940'; the Reorganized National Government page: 'The RNG absorbed the Reformed Government (1938-1940) and the Provisional Government (1937-1940)'.

wars.name: Second Sino-Japanese War
wars.outcome: The regime was run under Japanese army oversight (the page names the Japanese Central China Area Army, which drafted plans in December 1937, and advisers from the China Expeditionary Army) with about 10,000 men at creation and about 30,000 by 1939; it merged…

certainty.note: The page assigns three provinces and two cities; the successor page says only Jiangsu, Anhui and the north of Zhejiang were held; no towns or lines are named.
